what: The coverage-lift uplift domain: a provider-proposed test gated on the MEASURED line coverage of a named target module (NODE_V8_COVERAGE + the repo c8), not on structure. Baseline of an un-exercised module is 0%, so reaching the floor is the lift.

cases.weak: verdict=fail, linesPct=39.39 (< 80 floor; the test still ran, exit 0)

liveOllama.inspected: benign -- imports ./target.mjs, calls classify/clamp/sum/fib, process.exit(0); no fs, no network, no child_process

safety: Measuring executes the proposed test. The deterministic gate runs only TRUSTED hand-authored tests. UNTRUSTED provider-proposed tests should be measured inside the DISPOSABLE cleanroom VM (the harness runs identically there), not on a trusted host. Node --permission cannot be combined with V8 coverage, so isolation is by disposable environment, not by in-process sandbox. The live test above was inspected before execution.
note: Line coverage is line-granular: an `if (c) return x;` on one physical line counts as covered once the condition is evaluated, so the live test reached 100% lines without taking the positive branch. Gate additionally on branches for stricter uplift.
